messages:
Sam (oncall): quick follow-up from the postmortem — we've seen the 'partial-churn' recurrence on prod streaming across two clusters this week. Need clear owners and short timeline. TL;DR: timeouts + client reconnects + sticky KV cache causing partial responses.
Priya S.: thanks. can we list concrete action items and owners here? I can take coord for infra-side.
Lukas R.: I'll own runtime changes: increasing handshake timeout, adding clearer disconnect metrics. Plan: change default handshake timeout from 45s -> 75s, add metric 'stream.handshake_latency_ms' and 'stream.partial_response_count'.
Mei Chen: client SDK will add deterministic reconnect backoff and a 'resume' header to avoid duplicate partials. I'll submit PR with tests by 2026-04-02.
Diego: SRE will create a recurring incident drill weekly for 8 weeks and add dashboard alerts at 3x baseline. I'll set up alert thresholds and paging.
Priya S.: infra: add KV-cache eviction logging and make cache TTL visible per-tenant. Owner: Priya. ETA: 2026-04-05.
Lukas R.: runtime patch: code snippet incoming... ```yaml
stream:
  handshake_timeout_ms: 75000
  reconnect:
    base_backoff_ms: 200
    max_backoff_ms: 5000
    jitter: full
```
Mei Chen: SDK snippet I'll include: ```js
client.on('stream', (evt) => { if (evt.partial) buffer.push(evt.chunk) })
client.configureReconnect({ strategy: 'exp', base:200, cap:5000, resumeHeader: 'x-resume-token' })
```
Sam (oncall): agree on measurables: reduce partial-response-rate by 80% within 2 weeks; no P95 handshake > 60s. Add a short post-checkin on 2026-04-09.
Priya S.: created GH issue #redwood/infra/433 with tasks and linked to postmortem.
Lukas R.: opened runtime PR 789, request review from @Mei, @Diego.
Mei Chen: SDK PR 212 ready, unit tests added. CI flaky on macos, will fix by tomorrow.
infra-bot: deploy queued for runtime patch canary to 3% at 2026-03-29T10:30Z :rocket:
Sam (oncall): next sync: 2026-04-02 16:00 PT. Owners: Lukas (runtime), Mei (sdk), Priya (infra), Diego (sre). Ping me if blockers.
Diego: added weekly drill calendar invites for SRE rotation. I'll rotate ownership after 4 weeks to platform team.
Sam (oncall): closing this thread — we'll keep action tracking in the GH issue; update the issue with completed checks. :white_check_mark:
